title: Brass bands, funerals and Labor Day parades
summary: Harris played funerals and parades with Allen, Williams, the Eureka and Tuxedo bands before he was crippled.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: You ever played any brass bands around? You ever played in the parades and funerals?

Yeah, I used to play with old man Rowley, I mean, uh, Allen. Oh, man. Old man. I used to play with him. I'd play a funeral with George Williams. I'd play a funeral with, um, I don't know, before I got crippled, I used to play all the funerals and parades. And don't talk about Labor Day. You know, we had five or six bands on the street, we had Labor Day, we had bands, you know, we used to play all of that.
Labor Day. That years ago, you say, five or six bands on the street.
We had five or six bands on the street on Labor Day.
Labor Day, the 4th of July, every band in the city. And made the 10th around there. Yeah.

In other words, the brass band from the E-Ricka to the Tuxedo band, I played with both of them. Brass bands. That's what I was in, you know what I mean? Young man, nice young man. I got messed up. Turned a corner fast.
